name: Luke Stilson
title: Lead Technical Artist

profile: Lead Technical Artist with a multidisciplinary background in 3D art, shader and material authoring, real-time rendering, game development, and production software. Builds and maintains the workflows connecting creative teams, digital content creation tools, and game engines. Combines hands-on modeling, animation, and visual development with C#/Python tooling, runtime integration, and performance optimization.

Create and integrate polished game art, shader effects, animation, and reusable presentation systems with attention to visual quality and constrained target hardware.
Develop a flexible 2D shader framework with SDF-based outlines and shadows, light sweeps, gradients, color treatments, and reveal effects using per-instance controls.
Replace Animator-heavy content workflows with lightweight state-based animation control; improve atlas organization, texture compression, and runtime behavior.
